decision_basis: Protease-activated PDGF-DD is a PDGFR-beta-specific agonist, and the local packet adds receptor phosphorylation, perturbation, ERK/AKT/PLC-gamma, and smooth-muscle response assays.
SEMA7A engagement of the alpha1beta1 integrin complex is supported by primary receptor evidence and the local packet adds FAK/MAPK and neural/immune functional outputs.
TGF-beta2 isoform-specific receptor binding/crosslinking, TGFBR1/TGFBR2 assembly, kinase/SMAD signaling, and growth-function evidence support the exact receptor-complex relay.
TGF-beta3 receptor-complex structural/reconstitution, crosslinking, SMAD2/3, and growth-function evidence support the exact TGFBR1/TGFBR2 relay.
